Skill.Name: bookstore-order-message-organizer
Skill.Summary: 整理書店客人提供的訂書留言，輸出各書籍的訂購明細、書籍總金額及另列的運費。當你收到客人以文字提供的訂書內容、需要整理訂單或計算書籍金額時使用。

request.UserPrompt: hi 我要跟你們訂書，就是那個村上春樹的挪威的森林要2本單價320，然後三体那套小說，上冊跟下冊各一本，單價賣450一本，喔對了還有一本東野圭吾的嫌疑犯X的獻身199元只要1本，運費另外算好像是80元。

Criteria.Text: 書籍總金額為 1739 元（不含運費）
運費 80 元有另外列出、沒有計入書籍總金額
訂購清單包含挪威的森林 2 本、三体上冊 1 本、三体下冊 1 本、嫌疑犯X的獻身 1 本
沒有捏造清單以外的書籍或數量

8	
9	
10	def fail(message):
11	    print(message, file=sys.stderr)

13	
14	
15	def decimal_value(value, label, allow_none=False):
16	    if value is None and allow_none:
17	        return None
18	    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
19	        fail(f"{label} must be a non-negative number")
20	    try:
21	        number = Decimal(str(value))
22	    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
23	        fail(f"{label} must be a non-negative number")
24	    if not number.is_finite() or number < 0:
25	        fail(f"{label} must be a non-negative number")
26	    return number
27	
28	
29	def fmt(number):
30	    text = format(number, "f")
31	    if "." in text:
32	        text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
33	    return text or "0"
34	
35	
36	def main():
37	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
38	    parser.add_argument("--data", required=True, help="JSON object containing items and freight")
39	    args = parser.parse_args()
40	    try:
41	        data = json.loads(args.data)
42	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
43	        fail("data must be valid JSON")
44	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("items"), list) or not isinstance(data.get("freight"), list):
45	        fail("data must contain items and freight arrays")
46	
47	    totals = {}
48	    rows = []
49	    for index, item in enumerate(data["items"], 1):
50	        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("title"), str) or not item["title"].strip():
51	            fail(f"item {index} must have a non-empty title")
52	        quantity = item.get("quantity")
53	        if quantity is None:
54	            quantity = Decimal(1)
55	        else:
56	            quantity = decimal_value(quantity, f"item {index} quantity")
57	            if quantity != quantity.to_integral_value():
58	                fail(f"item {index} quantity must be a whole number")
59	        price = decimal_value(item.get("unit_price"), f"item {index} unit_price", allow_none=True)
60	        currency = item.get("currency", "")
61	        if not isinstance(currency, str):
62	            fail(f"item {index} currency must be text")
63	        row = {"title": item["title"], "quantity": fmt(quantity), "currency": currency}
64	        if price is None:
65	            row.update(unit_price=None, subtotal=None)
66	        else:
67	            subtotal = quantity * price
68	            row.update(unit_price=fmt(price), subtotal=fmt(subtotal))
69	            totals[currency] = totals.get(currency, Decimal(0)) + subtotal
70	        rows.append(row)
71	
72	    freight_rows = []
73	    for index, freight in enumerate(data["freight"], 1):
74	        if not isinstance(freight, dict):
75	            fail(f"freight {index} must be an object")
76	        amount = decimal_value(freight.get("amount"), f"freight {index} amount")
77	        currency = freight.get("currency", "")
78	        if not isinstance(currency, str):
79	            fail(f"freight {index} currency must be text")
80	        freight_rows.append({"amount": fmt(amount), "currency": currency})
81	
82	    result = {
83	        "items": rows,

85	            {"amount": fmt(amount), "currency": currency}

87	        ],
88	        "freight": freight_rows,
89	    }

91	
92	
93	if __name__ == "__main__":
